posts.author: fuzzbyte
posts.body:
So I've recently bought RPG Maker 2003 and whenever I start a blank project (Actually could be any) it auto mutes all the system and I have to manually put the volume up a bit so it's not muted, how do I solve that? I can live with it but it is kinda annoying
Ver. 1.12a from Steam

posts.author: Dark_Ansem
posts.body: as in it mutes your windows audio?

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
If it were in Rm2k it could just be the audios in MIDI format, but in this case it could just be because of the configuration menu.
Open the "Video Options" menu by pressing the F5 key, uncheck this option and save by pressing the [OK] button:
This option is probably affecting all your projects.
Take advantage and read the manual as there are some very interesting things in this version that many devs don't know:
